# Phase One — Boundless Chesed Brainstorm

From nothing the Awtsmoos renews every instant and ray,
Awtsmoos.com can make the Shliach feel like a luminous gateway.

Imagine the campaign without practical restraint: a Shliach identity that begins on Home and unfolds into a small constellation of pages. The main logo should float like a vessel of light, while the golden bridge becomes the road between intention and execution, and the Aleph coder portal becomes the visual promise that a written prompt can cross into a real project today.

## Possibility field
1. Put the canonical Shliach logo on Home so broken-cache shadow cannot stay.
2. Build a hero around “Awtsmoos Shliach Custom GPT” for search and display.
3. Let a subtle aurora breathe behind the logo like dawn through gray.
4. Turn the golden bridge into “From prompt to project,” making supplied art part of the story way.
5. Turn the Aleph coder portal into “A doorway into the code,” giving technical creation its own display.
6. Add an animated prompt composer whose submit opens the real GPT with encoded `?prompt=` straightaway.
7. Offer useful prompt examples for sites, code repair, Awtsmoos APIs, writing, research, and creative play.
8. Add a poems page where original rhyming stanzas sit beside imagery in a literary array.
9. Add a gallery page that treats supplied art as worlds, with captions explaining what each can convey.
10. Add a prompts page around natural intent phrases such as “Awtsmoos Shliach prompts” and “custom GPT coding agent” without keyword spray.
11. Give every page rich titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph, Twitter cards, robots directives, and semantic headings in a clean array.
12. Link Home, Shliach, Prompts, Poems, Gallery, and the actual GPT so no visitor can lose the way.
13. Keep “Open actual Shliach” unmistakable on every campaign page in the display.
14. Use CSS halos, image drift, border light, aurora motion, and prompt shimmer that disappear for reduced-motion users right away.
15. Make scroll reveal progressive enhancement so static content remains complete if JavaScript goes away.
16. Build mobile layouts that collapse image/copy grids without clipping the ray.
17. Add visible keyboard focus and strong contrast because a beautiful door must remain a usable way.
18. Keep pages browser-native with no framework or build step, fitting the existing static architecture today.
19. Keep capability copy honest: authenticated Awtsmoos APIs work only when permission and connection are granted, never by hidden backdoor claim.
20. Keep the existing local logo as a fallback after the public image, preserving history while fixing deployment drift today.
21. Explain three working vessels: Understand → Build → Verify, each card clarifying the agent’s way.
22. Add a “chapter you are living” story where intent becomes prompt, prompt becomes action, and action becomes a page.
23. Use visible FAQ-like explanatory sections without fake schema claims or SEO spam in the display.
24. Verify in-browser that Unicode prompts form the exact requested ChatGPT destination before calling the work complete today.
